turns.question: Can you explain the CAP theorem and how it applies to distributed databases?
turns.response: Yeah so I think CAP theorem is about consistency, availability, and partition tolerance. From what I remember, you can only pick two of the three. I guess in a distributed system, network partitions can happen, so you usually have to choose between consistency and availability. I believe MongoDB is kind of AP and something like Spanner is CP? I'm not totally sure. In my experience with small projects, I haven't really had to deal with this directly, so I might be missing some nuances.
